purpose: Reviewer-only historical availability checks. A proof can validate an eligible own-date frozen headline; it cannot add absent facts or later article text.
historical_vintage_limit: Current retrieval of dated official releases or publication metadata is evidence of the recorded release schedule/event, not an archived original server response or complete contemporary article-body vintage.
timezone_conversion: Asia/Tokyo is UTC+09:00. An 08:30/08:50 JST release occurs at 23:30/23:50 UTC on the previous day. An announcement at or after 09:00 JST is outside that local day’s 00:00 UTC report cutoff.
admission_scope: These underlying official-release proofs do not establish that a current publisher article body existed before the cutoff. Admit only facts already present in an eligible own-date frozen headline. Do not add numbers from these proofs without that headline.
